scripts.validate:schemas: node -e "const Ajv=require('ajv');const add=require('ajv-formats');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const ajv=new Ajv({allErrors:true});add(ajv);const dir=path.join('infra','api','schemas');for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)){const p=path.join(dir,f);const sch=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));ajv.compile(sch);}console.log('Schemas OK');"
